-# Entire Worktree Hooks
+# Entire Worktree Hooks
 
-[TODO: Add the task-specific guidance Codex needs. Reference supporting files only when they are relevant.]
+Use this skill when a task creates, repairs, or starts work in an Entire-enabled
+Git worktree and Codex reports `trust_review_needed`, missing hook approvals, or
+unpushed checkpoints.
+
+Run the bundled synchronizer from the target worktree:
+
+```sh
+python /Users/johnlee/.codex/skills/entire-worktree-hooks/scripts/sync.py \
+  --worktree /absolute/path/to/worktree --enable-push
+```
+
+The synchronizer:
+
+- reads the user-level Codex config, never a repository credential or secret;
+- finds an already-approved `.codex/hooks.json` with identical bytes;
+- copies only the matching per-hook `trusted_hash` records to the new absolute
+  worktree path;
+- refuses to approve a hook file that differs from every approved source;
+- writes ignored `.entire/settings.local.json` only when `--enable-push` is
+  explicitly requested; and
+- verifies the result with `entire doctor` and `entire status --json`.
+
+Do not copy trust records when hook contents differ. Surface that as a review
+requirement instead. Do not alter `.codex/hooks.json`, repository history, or
+remote configuration as part of this skill.
+
+After creating a worktree, run this before delegating an agent into it. If the
+user asks for session history to be visible remotely, include `--enable-push`
+and push the resulting Entire checkpoint refs through the configured checkpoint
+remote after verifying the destination.
*** Add File: /Users/johnlee/.codex/skills/entire-worktree-hooks/scripts/sync.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Reuse approved Codex hook hashes for an identical Entire worktree config."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+BLOCK_RE = re.compile(
+    r'^\[hooks\.state\."(?P<path>.+?):(?P<event>[^:]+):(?P<index>\d+):(?P<subindex>\d+)"\]\n'
+    r'trusted_hash = "(?P<hash>[^"]+)"\n?',
+    re.MULTILINE,
+)
+
+
+def run(*args: str, cwd: Path | None = None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
+    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+
+
+def config_path() -> Path:
+    codex_home = Path.home() / ".codex"
+    return Path(__import__("os").environ.get("CODEX_HOME", str(codex_home))) / "config.toml"
+
+
+def hook_path(worktree: Path) -> Path:
+    path = worktree / ".codex" / "hooks.json"
+    if not path.is_file():
+        raise SystemExit(f"missing hook file: {path}")
+    return path
+
+
+def approved_blocks(text: str) -> list[re.Match[str]]:
+    return list(BLOCK_RE.finditer(text))
+
+
+def enable_push(worktree: Path) -> None:
+    settings = worktree / ".entire" / "settings.local.json"
+    settings.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    settings.write_text('{\n  "strategy_options": {\n    "push_sessions": true\n  }\n}\n')
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--worktree", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--enable-push", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    worktree = args.worktree.expanduser().resolve()
+    target = hook_path(worktree)
+    cfg = config_path()
+    if not cfg.is_file():
+        raise SystemExit(f"missing Codex config: {cfg}")
+
+    text = cfg.read_text()
+    matches = approved_blocks(text)
+    target_bytes = target.read_bytes()
+    target_key = str(target)
+    existing = {m.group("path"): m for m in matches}
+
+    source_paths = sorted({m.group("path") for m in matches if Path(m.group("path")).is_file()})
+    source = next((Path(path) for path in source_paths if Path(path).read_bytes() == target_bytes), None)
+    if source is None:
+        raise SystemExit("no approved hook file with identical bytes; manual /hooks review is required")
+
+    source_matches = [m for m in matches if m.group("path") == str(source)]
+    if not source_matches:
+        raise SystemExit(f"approved source has no trust records: {source}")
+
+    additions: list[str] = []
+    for match in source_matches:
+        suffix = f'{match.group("event")}:{match.group("index")}:{match.group("subindex")}'
+        key = f"{target_key}:{suffix}"
+        old = existing.get(target_key)
+        if old is not None:
+            same = [m for m in matches if m.group("path") == target_key and f'{m.group("event")}:{m.group("index")}:{m.group("subindex")}' == suffix]
+            if same and same[0].group("hash") == match.group("hash"):
+                continue
+            if same:
+                raise SystemExit(f"existing trust hash differs for {key}; manual review required")
+        additions.append(
+            f'[hooks.state."{key}"]\ntrusted_hash = "{match.group("hash")}"\n'
+        )
+
+    if additions:
+        with cfg.open("a") as handle:
+            handle.write("\n" + "\n".join(additions))
+    if args.enable_push:
+        enable_push(worktree)
+
+    doctor = run("entire", "doctor", cwd=worktree)
+    status = run("entire", "status", "--json", cwd=worktree)
+    print(f"worktree={worktree}")
+    print(f"source={source}")
+    print(f"trust_records_added={len(additions)}")
+    print(f"push_sessions={'enabled' if args.enable_push else 'unchanged'}")
+    print(doctor.stdout, end="")
+    print(status.stdout, end="")
+    if doctor.returncode or status.returncode:
+        print(doctor.stderr, end="", file=sys.stderr)
+        print(status.stderr, end="", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch";
